tools.name: quendoo_list_properties
tools.description: List the hotel properties this token reaches, with name, type, currency, star rating and mode (shadow or live). Good first call to get a property_id. Connect API: GET /properties.

tools.name: quendoo_get_property
tools.description: Read one property: address, contact details, check-in and check-out times, currency and mode. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}.

tools.name: quendoo_get_structure
tools.description: Read the whole structure of one property: room types, rate plans and their links. One call instead of several. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/structure.

tools.name: quendoo_list_room_types
tools.description: List the room types of one property, with capacity, quantity and partner code. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/room_types.

tools.name: quendoo_list_rate_plans
tools.description: List the rate plans of one property: room type, meal plan, cancellation and payment policy, and occupancy rates. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/rate_plans.

tools.name: quendoo_get_availability
tools.description: Read the calendar per day and room type: rooms open, booked and free to sell. Use a date range of a few weeks. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/availability.

tools.name: quendoo_get_rates
tools.description: Read the prices and restrictions of one rate plan over a date range. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/rate_plans/{rate_plan_id}/rates.

tools.name: quendoo_search_offers
tools.description: Search the offers a property sells for dates and a party. Returns each offer with a search_token (valid 30 minutes) to book with quendoo_book_from_search. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/booking_offers.

tools.name: quendoo_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings of one property, filtered by check-in or check-out window, status or guest name. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/bookings.

tools.name: quendoo_get_booking
tools.description: Read one booking: status, payment status, dates, total amount and payment plan. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/bookings/{booking_id}.

tools.name: quendoo_get_cancellation_quote
tools.description: Read what cancelling a booking costs today, under its cancellation policy. Makes no change. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/bookings/{booking_id}/cancellation_quote.

tools.name: quendoo_list_booking_revisions
tools.description: Read the booking change feed: created, changed and cancelled bookings not yet acknowledged. Pass next_cursor as since to continue. Reading does not acknowledge. Connect API: GET /booking_revisions/feed.

tools.name: quendoo_update_availability
tools.description: Set the rooms to sell, and open or close room types, for date ranges. Send up to 1000 rows per call; a row covers a date range. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/inventory/availability. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true and nothing i

tools.name: quendoo_update_rates
tools.description: Set the price of a rate plan on a room type for date ranges. Send up to 1000 rows per call. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/inventory/rates. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true and nothing is stored.

tools.name: quendoo_update_restrictions
tools.description: Set stay restrictions (minimum or maximum nights, stop sell, closed to arrival or departure) for date ranges. Send up to 900 rows per call. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/inventory/restrictions. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true a

tools.name: quendoo_book_from_search
tools.description: Create a real booking from a search_token and the offers the guest chose. Confirm the guest, dates and price first. Returns the payment_url to send to the guest. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/bookings/from_search. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the an

tools.name: quendoo_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a whole booking. Read quendoo_get_cancellation_quote first and confirm the cost with the user. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/bookings/{booking_id}/cancel.

tools.name: quendoo_ack_booking_revision
tools.description: Acknowledge one booking change from quendoo_list_booking_revisions after you saved it. Acknowledging the same change again is safe. Connect API: POST /booking_revisions/{id}/ack.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quendoo_list_booking_revisions, quendoo_update_availability, quendoo_book_from_search, quendoo_cancel_booking · Private data: quendoo_list_properties, quendoo_get_property · Public sink: quendoo_update_availability, quendoo_update_rates, quendoo_update_restrictions, quendoo_book_from_search, quendoo_cancel_booking, quendoo_ack_booking_revision.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quendoo_list_booking_revisions, quendoo_update_availability, quendoo_book_from_search, quendoo_cancel_booking · Private data: quendoo_list_properties, quendoo_get_property · Public sink: quendoo_update_availability, quendoo_update_rates, quendoo_update_restrictions, quendoo_book_from_search, quendoo_cancel_booking, quendoo_ack_booking_revision

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
